what_this_is: Authorization for the one, single exploratory run -- typed and pinned BEFORE any computation against any locked peer's real returns happens. make_hyp08_phase3_run.py refuses to run without it.
what_this_is_not: Not a result, not a retroactive declaration, and not itself a computation.
attestation_text: I authorize the one, single exploratory run of HYP-08's locked spec against the real returns of every one of its 31 locked peers around every one of its 973 locked anchor events, evaluating both preregistered tests: the plain pooled same-session coefficient and the shock:is_competitor heterogeneity interaction. I understand significance is judged by a closed-form Sidak-corrected critical t-value at k=2 exact tests, not a permutation null, and that this is a deliberate design choice, not a lowered bar. I understand the a priori prediction is a positive coefficient for customer/supplier peers and a negative one for competitor peers, and that whichever result actually comes back -- for either test, in either direction, or null -- will be reported as computed. I understand this cannot be undone or repeated.
how_it_is_used: make_hyp08_phase3_run.py verifies: exactly one authorization exists, declared is true, consumed is false, and every pinned hash matches what is on disk. It marks this consumed the instant a real run succeeds.
